summary: Albemarle County, VA steel lookout built 1933 near Charlottesville; privately owned, NHLR-registered 2020, removed March 2023. No staffing or fire record found.

facts.status_note: Removed in March 2023 per both registers; no source describes what remains on the site

access.note: Privately owned; the register describes no public access

events.note: Built 1933 per NHLR description (privately owned 100-foot steel tower)
Federal survey station record (Coast and Geodetic Survey, 1958) describes the tower and its glass room
Registered March 24, 2020 as US 1410, VA 42; nominated by John McDonald
Removed March 2023 per NHLR description; both registers say 2023

evidence.quote: This privately owned 100-foot steel tower was built in 1933.

evidence.supports: fenced in with communications equipment on the tower and in the cab before removal in March 2023
evidence.quote: Prior to its removal in March 2023, it was fenced in with communications equipment on the tower and in the cab.

evidence.supports: administered by a private owner, so no public access described

evidence.quote: January 1997 photo - courtesy of Mark Haughwout

evidence.supports: removed March 2023 per FFLOS site record
evidence.quote: Prior to its removal in March 2023

evidence.supports: about four miles south of Charlottesville, on Carter Mountain
evidence.quote: ABOUT 4 MILES SOUTH OF CHARLOTTESVILLE, ON CARTER MOUNTAIN.

evidence.supports: 1958 federal survey description of the station
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1958 (JCC)

evidence.supports: survey station at the apex of the roof of an 8-foot-square glass room
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS THE APEX OF THE ROOF OF THE 8 FOOT SQUARE, GLASS ENCLOSED ROOM OF THE LOOKOUT TOWER.

evidence.supports: four steel legs, about 100 feet high
evidence.quote: BY 4 STRUCTURAL STEEL LEGS AND IS ABOUT 100 FEET HIGH.

notes_for_editor: Only three sources. Dates agree across NHLR and FFLOS (built 1933, removed March 2023). No staffing, fire or ownership history found in two web searches; the Forest Lookouts page carries only a 1958 federal survey description. An inactive FCC antenna registration on Carters Mountain Trail (Network Towers LLC, FCC 1321710) exists, but no source ties it to the lookout, so the story does not use it. Site today not described anywhere. Brief's 'Private Owner' agency kept; brief's access 'unknown' upgraded to private from the owner field.
